title: Attention via Aether-Obsidian Vector Search: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a C++ Balanced Index
author: Mateus Yonathan

abstract: We present a compact, height-balanced index that supports attention-style vector retrieval in C++. The design couples a binary-search-like traversal with a lightweight node layout that preserves key order and strict height balance, enabling deterministic $O(\log N)$ point and range queries. Formal invariants are maintained through local rebalancing rotations that are provably safe under concurrent insertions. The algorithmic structure is expressed as a single templated class with contiguous node packing, yielding a minimal AST footprint. No runtime profiling was performed; all guarantees are derived from static analysis and formal proofs. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/cpp-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261009_000212_attention_via_black-box_vector}
